The company plans to raise up to C$14M through a best-efforts private placement of up to 43.75M Units at C$0.32 per unit.
Each Unit consists of one common share and one-half of one warrant, with each whole warrant exercisable at US$0.32 per share.
The warrants will be exercisable from 61 days after closing until 24 months after the closing date.
The agent also has an option to sell up to 6.25M additional Units, potentially raising another C$2M.
